name: GSurf SDF Learning from Gaussians
definition: A method to fit a Signed Distance Field (SDF) directly to Gaussian centroids to provide geometric regularization and rich geometric cues for appearance modeling, addressing holes and surface irregularities common in TSDF fusion.
summary: GSurf fits a Signed Distance Field to 3D Gaussian centroids, providing geometric regularization that overcomes TSDF holes and differs from vanilla Gaussian splatting by enforcing high opacity.
